text:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GPU supply + autoscale. Can leadership clarify prefill windows and capacity tagging for holiday traffic? Not sure how RegionalPrefill interacts with Dedicated pools. TL;DR: do we need to change app-level routing to hit prefilled pools? cc @raj @lead-cto

raj: Great q. Short answer: prefill is a regional signal, not a per-pool tag. Dedicated pools can opt-in via pool_label 'prefill:true' — we'll add docs. For now, if you need guaranteed warm nodes during holidays, raise a support ticket. :white_check_mark:

lead-cto: Adding color: prefill windows are treated as 4-48h ops reservations, not continuous background warming. We will expose a UI toggle in Console in the next sprint. Goal is to avoid prewarming every single pool by default. :spiral_calendar:

kevin: Ops note: autoscaler will ignore prefill tagging for burst capacity; it'll still scale to spot/overflow when demand spikes. So prefill is for lower-latency steady traffic, not emergency burst protection.

anya: To confirm, if we set pool_label 'prefill:true' and pin model_version, you get warm KV cache and model weights staying resident? @raj

raj: Yes — you'll get warm KV and cached weights depending on how long the prefill window runs. But note: if we change kernel/quantization paths during the window, some cold loads may still happen.

raj: example config:
```yaml
pool_name: ml-prefill-1
labels:
  prefill: "true"
  region: us-west-2
reserved: 10
``` 

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: Scheduled prefill job created for region-us-west-2 window 2024-12-21T00:00Z -> 2024-12-24T00:00Z. ID: prefill-2024-holiday-001

leo: Any cost estimation for keeping 50 nodes warm for 72h? Will billing show under Dedicated commitments or as metered usage? :money_with_wings:

derek: Short answer: depends. If you reserved capacity it counts against Dedicated commitment; if not, it shows as metered prefill-reservation line item. We'll publish example scenarios.

billing: We'll produce a cost sheet w/ 3 scenarios (reserved, on-demand, mixed) and example numbers by EOD Friday.

sre: We'll run a canary prefill next week in us-west-2 with a small model to validate cold-start numbers and scaling behavior. Will post results here.

maria: Action items: @raj to publish short doc on pool labels + examples; @billing to publish example costs; @sre to run a canary prefill next week. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
